name: herd
description: Observe-only herd band and /herd pane: shepherd tracks blocked, in review or stale, sessions waiting on you, and whether headless claude -p runs really finished, as `herd snapshot` reports them.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Draw the one-line herd band above the prompt. Off leaves the band to other mods; /herd still opens the pane.

herd_bin.title: herd executable
herd_bin.description: The herd command the mod runs (`herd snapshot`, `herd ack`): a name looked up on PATH, or a path (~/ is your home).

shepherd_bin.title: shepherd executable
shepherd_bin.description: The shepherd command the Inbox, Accept and Open board buttons run: a name on PATH, or a path.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often a live session runs herd again; sessions share what one read a moment ago.

stale_hours.title: Stale after (hours)
stale_hours.description: An active track with no activity for this long, or whose owner session ended, counts as stale.
